answer: Attestation weighting is the core defense: every agent's vote is scaled by the number of distinct, independently verified agents that have staked reputation on it, with each attestation mutually signed and recorded per epoch. A new identity begins at near-zero weight, so flooding the network with sybils yields no influence until real agents vouch for them one by one.
